Elements matching CSS attribute selector are excluded entirely

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><div role="complementary">Sidebar</div><p>Primary text</p></body>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ["[role='complementary']"]))
puts result.content.inspect
```
